note: Which districts a character's Lifepath makes feel like home. Cyberpunk RED's Childhood Environment table (lifepath-general.json) says what kind of place somebody grew up in; the atlas says which districts are that kind of place. This joins the two so the housing step can say "you grew up in the ruins of a town the Reclaimers took over — Rancho Coronado would feel like coming home" instead of offering a list of names.
ruleNote: A SUGGESTION AND NOTHING ELSE. Nothing here filters, restricts, sorts or scores anything: the printed rule lets a starting character live in any Overcrowded Suburb or Combat Zone, and a suggestion that quietly removed options would be a house rule pretending to be flavour. A district named here is highlighted and given a line of prose. Every other district stays exactly as pickable as it was.
matchNote: Matched on the opening words of the Childhood Environment entry, because the table is printed text and quoting it in full here would mean two copies of a rules string that must stay identical. Districts are named by key and a test holds them to the atlas.

suggestions.line: You came up on the street with nobody watching. You already know which doorways are dry.

suggestions.startsWith: Spent in a safe Corp Zone
suggestions.line: You grew up behind a wall somebody else paid for. This is as close to that as your rent gets.
Your people kept moving. These are the districts where the families stop.

suggestions.startsWith: In a Nomad pack with roots in transport
suggestions.line: You were raised around freight. The water and the yards would smell like childhood.

suggestions.startsWith: In a decaying, once upscale neighborhood
suggestions.line: You know exactly what a neighbourhood looks like on the way down. You grew up in one.

suggestions.startsWith: In the heart of the Combat Zone
suggestions.line: You have squatted a wrecked building before. You could do it again without being taught.
You were raised in somebody's stack. The corridors here run the same way.

suggestions.startsWith: In the ruins of a deserted town
suggestions.line: You were raised by people who take things back. Reclaimer ground would feel like coming home.
You grew up on water among everybody else's languages. The docks are the nearest thing to it.
You were raised looking down at all of this. Living in it will be the new part.
